entries.title: Reweighted Wake-Sleep
entries.read: Introduction; sections 2.1–2.4, equations 1–5 and Algorithm 1; beginning of experiments. No complete experimental/appendix review.
entries.finding: Likelihood importance estimates and self-normalized gradient estimates have different bias properties. The latter is generally biased at finite K; proposals require support and known probabilities. This is an ordinary baseline for unannotated decisions.

entries.title: Language Models are Hidden Reasoners: Unlocking Latent Reasoning Capabilities via Self-Rewarding
entries.read: Sections 3–4.3, equations 2–4 and Algorithm 1; section 5.1 configuration and section 6 limitations. No complete tables, appendices or image review.
entries.finding: LaTRO uses expected answer log likelihood and a reference KL with a reason score-function term plus an explicit answer-likelihood derivative. This differs from log marginal answer likelihood. Its published core already covers learning without annotated reasons.

entries.title: Training Chain-of-Thought via Latent-Variable Inference
entries.read: Targeted re-read of section 2, Algorithm 1 and section 2.1; earlier complete notebook review is linked in observation_alignment, not repeated here.
entries.finding: TRICE's parameter-independent answer checker differs from a learned action likelihood; replacing it requires including both parameter derivatives. A reference action is not the set of all valid 3D actions.

entries.title: Importance Weighted Autoencoders
entries.read: Abstract, background and section 3 lower-bound statement/Theorem 1; not complete training derivation or experiments.
entries.finding: Expected log importance estimates define a lower-bound objective; they should not be confused with an unbiased marginal-likelihood gradient. No IWAE reproduction claimed.
